spanish: Y a tu bestia y a la viva que en tu tierra, será todo su producto para comer.

findings.issue: Noun (feminine singular) is rendered with the adjective viva used as a noun, so the creature sense is thin.

notes: Conjunctions, ל, article on לַחַיָּה, singulars, 2ms suffixes, relative, 3fs on the produce, and the qal infinitive are preserved.
